elements.label: Table 2.1
elements.title: Fields Where Observation Methods Are Used
elements.details:
| Field      | Data Collected By           | Purpose                                                      |
|------------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Education  | Teachers                   | To monitor and assess student behavior and learning progress in the classroom |
| Psychology | Therapists and psychologists | To gather information about their clients' behavior, thoughts, and emotions |
elements.summary: This table summarizes examples of fields that use observational data, specifying who collects the data and the purpose of the data collection.
